Your air conditioner requires annual servicing. When you choose us, expect a thorough examination of your A/C system to identify potential issues before they become costly problems. Our comprehensive checklist covers operating pressures, temperatures, belt tensions, coils, wiring, and safety switches. We also lubricate moving parts, adjust belts, clean accessible coils, and calibrate your thermostat, guaranteeing your system operates safely and efficiently.

Like your A/C, your heating system needs a yearly inspection. Our comprehensive annual service covers thermostat checks, burner cleaning, fan assessments, air filtration, moving parts lubrication, full furnace cycle checks, gas leak inspections, and belt adjustments. We thoroughly examine your entire system to address potential issues early, ensuring you enjoy a worry-free, cozy indoor environment when cold weather arrives.

An attic fan combats summer heat and humidity by expelling hot air and drawing in cooler outside air, easing the workload on your A/C and maintaining a comfortable living space. In winter, it keeps insulation dry to prevent unnecessary strain on your heating system. Overall, these fans provide a more efficient HVAC system, reduce the need for repairs, improve indoor comfort, and lower your monthly energy bills.

Gas logs provide convenient, energy-efficient heating and a cozy fireplace ambiance at the push of a button, without the mess and hassle of traditional wood. However, low maintenance doesn’t mean no maintenance. Regular professional check-ins are still essential to keep your gas logs operating well. Whether you need to book a routine service or install new gas logs, you can count on us.
